LITTLE DIARY

Some things are too small to say out loud, so I kept them in this little diary.

I’ve fallen for the little things about you — your kutty kutty expressions, that irritated face, the reddish blush when you get angry, and those eyes that can kill with just a single glance. ✨

The way your earrings seem to have endless conversations with you… When you gently adjust your hair, even that simple little gesture… even the smallest things about you feel romantic to me. Maybe these are just ordinary little things to the rest of the world, but somehow, my eyes have always found something extraordinary in them.

Character-wise, you’re Pikachu ⚡. In certain times you’re Cinderella 🪄. You’re the queen of one particular colour 💚, devotionally you’re Madura Veeri 🔱, technically a 🤳, and sometimes a butterfly 🦋 who is almost impossible to find.

You have so many little versions of yourself, and somehow, I find something special in every one of them.

You’re still the one I’ve been waiting for, without ever knowing how to stop. 💫

Wishing you a very Happy Birthday! 🎈🎉🌹

May every little wish hidden in your heart find its way to you. May life give you countless reasons to smile, just as you’ve unknowingly given me countless reasons to admire you.

And today, among all the wishes you receive, accept my D E S E O...

Signing off,
DINOZR ✨💐
